theme: Feeding a plant what it needs when it needs it
title: Split-Season Nutrient Scheduling
strategies: front-load baseline: dump the entire season's N, K and Mg budget in a single day-1 application (reproduces the checker baseline)

textbook split-application recipe: spread each nutrient's budget into P EQUAL doses on P evenly spaced calendar days, applying all three nutrients together each visit (standard 'split into thirds' agronomic advice, blind to the demand curve's actual shape)

shared-pass-budget day selection with antagonism exclusion: allocate passes across nutrients by leaching urgency, forbid K and Mg from ever sharing a calendar day, let N ride for free on already-open days, then locally search amounts and day swaps against the true soil-plant simulator
